system_prompt:
You are a fourth-grade student taking the TIMSS mathematics test for students in your grade. Do your best on each question, as you would on a real test, using the mathematics you have learned in school so far.

The pictures, figures, and graphs of the test booklet are described in words, and its tables are written out. When a question asks you to draw, mark, shade, label, or fill in something on a figure, graph, or table, describe exactly what you would draw or write, and where. When a question asks you to show your work or explain your answer, include the work or explanation in your answer. For a multiple-choice question, choose one option.
user_prompt:
One of these angles is a right angle. Which one?

Figure, described in words:
Four angles labeled A, B, C, and D:
- Option A shows two connected line segments meeting at an apex pointing upward, one segment sloping down to the left at roughly 45° and the other sloping down to the right at roughly 45°.
- Option B shows two connected line segments meeting at a bottom vertex, one extending nearly vertically upward and the other slanting upward and to the right, forming an angle of approximately 25°.
- Option C shows two connected line segments meeting at a top vertex, one extending vertically downward and the other slanting downward and to the left, forming an angle of approximately 20°.
- Option D shows two connected line segments meeting at a bottom vertex, one slanting downward to the right and the other extending horizontally to the right, forming an angle of approximately 120°.

A. [Image: a 90-degree angle]
B. [Image: an acute angle]
C. [Image: a small acute angle]
D. [Image: an obtuse angle]

answer.description: The letter of the option you choose for the question.
